6// Returns Morton index in output array for a coarse node
7size_t coarseNodeToOutputIndex(size_t mortonL, size_t l, size_t t)
8{
9 dim3 p_l = decodeMorton3D(mortonL); // coarse-level coordinates
10 uint32_t scale = 1u << (t - l); // size of block in target LOD
11
12 dim3 p_t;
13 p_t.x = p_l.x * scale;
14 p_t.y = p_l.y * scale;
15 p_t.z = p_l.z * scale;
16
17 return morton3D(p_t.x, p_t.y, p_t.z);
18}

20uint8_t readNibble( const std::vector<uint8_t>& encodedData, size_t& bytePos, bool& highNibbleNext)
21{
22 if (bytePos >= encodedData.size())
23 throw std::runtime_error("End of compressed stream");
24
25 uint8_t byte = encodedData[bytePos];
26 uint8_t nib;
27
28 if (highNibbleNext)
29 {
30 nib = byte >> 4; // upper 4 bits
31 highNibbleNext = false; // next time read the low nibble
32 }
33 else
34 {
35 nib = byte & 0x0F; // lower 4 bits
36 highNibbleNext = true;
37 bytePos++; // we consumed the whole byte now
38 }
39
40 return nib;
41}

43std::tuple<OpType, uint8_t, uint8_t> readNextOperationAndStopBit( const std::vector<uint8_t>& encodedData, size_t& bytePos, bool& highNibbleNext)
44{
45 // Read primary nibble (OpCode + stopBit)
46 uint8_t nib = readNibble(encodedData, bytePos, highNibbleNext);
47
48 uint8_t opCode = nib >> 1; // 3-bit opcode
49 uint8_t stop = nib & 1; // LSB = stop flag
50
51 OpType op = static_cast<OpType>(opCode);
52
53 // Optional: read delta nibble for Pδ
54 uint8_t delta = 0;
55 if (op == OpType::PaletteBackD)
56 delta = readNibble(encodedData, bytePos, highNibbleNext);
57
58 return { op, stop, delta };
59}

61void fillSubBlock(size_t nodeMortonIdx, size_t level, size_t targetLOD, LabelType label, std::vector<LabelType>& out)
62{
63 size_t l = level;
64 size_t t = targetLOD;
65
66 // Compute start index in output array
67 size_t startIdx = coarseNodeToOutputIndex(nodeMortonIdx, l, t);
68
69 // Compute number of voxels in the subtree
70 size_t blockSize = 1ULL << (3 * (t - l)); // 8^(t-l) = 2^(3*(t-l))
71
72 // Fill entire block
73 for (size_t i = 0; i < blockSize; ++i)
74 out[startIdx + i] = label;
75}

77LabelType getNeighborValue(const std::vector<LabelType>& out, size_t level, size_t childMortonIdx, OpType op, size_t targetLOD)
78{
79 // Decode Morton index -> 3D coordinates
80 dim3 childCoords = Utils::decodeMorton3D(childMortonIdx);
81
82 // Extract LOCAL position in the 2×2×2 sibling block
83 int lx = childCoords.x & 1;
84 int ly = childCoords.y & 1;
85 int lz = childCoords.z & 1;
86
87 // Select which axis to move along based on operation type and update coordinates
88 int nx = childCoords.x;
89 int ny = childCoords.y;
90 int nz = childCoords.z;
91
92 if (op == OpType::NeighborX)
93 nx = (lx == 0) ? childCoords.x - 1 : childCoords.x + 1;
94 else if (op == OpType::NeighborY)
95 ny = (ly == 0) ? childCoords.y - 1 : childCoords.y + 1;
96 else if (op == OpType::NeighborZ)
97 nz = (lz == 0) ? childCoords.z - 1 : childCoords.z + 1;
98
99 // Check bounds - if neighbor is outside brick, use parent of current node
100 size_t maxCoord = (1 << (level + 1)) - 1;
101 if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nz < 0 || nx > (int)maxCoord || ny > (int)maxCoord || nz > (int)maxCoord)
102 {
103 uint32_t parentMorton = Utils::morton3D(childCoords.x >> 1, childCoords.y >> 1, childCoords.z >> 1);
104 size_t parentOutIdx = coarseNodeToOutputIndex(parentMorton, level, targetLOD);
105 return out[parentOutIdx];
106 }
107
108 // Neighbor Morton index with adjusted coordinates
109 size_t neighborMorton = Utils::morton3D(nx, ny, nz);
110
111 // Already decoded → use neighbor
112 if (neighborMorton < childMortonIdx)
113 {
114 size_t outIdx = coarseNodeToOutputIndex(neighborMorton, level + 1, targetLOD);
115 LabelType val = out[outIdx];
116 return val;
117 }
118
119 // Later Z → fallback to neighbor's parent
120 uint32_t parentMorton = Utils::morton3D(nx >> 1, ny >> 1, nz >> 1);
121 size_t parentOutIdx = coarseNodeToOutputIndex(parentMorton, level, targetLOD);
122 LabelType parentVal = out[parentOutIdx];
123 return parentVal;
124}

126inline uint32_t findSymbol(uint32_t x, const RansModel& m)
127{
128 uint32_t s = 0;
129 while (s + 1 < m.cumulativeFreq.size() &&
130 x >= m.cumulativeFreq[s + 1])

132 ++s;

137uint8_t ransDecodeSymbol(uint32_t& state, const std::vector<uint8_t>& in, size_t& inPos, const RansModel& model)
138{
139 uint32_t x = state % model.totalFreq;
140
141 uint32_t s = findSymbol(x, model); // cumulative lookup
142 uint32_t freq = model.freq[s];
143 uint32_t start = model.cumulativeFreq[s];
144
145 state = freq * (state / model.totalFreq) + (x - start);
146
147 while (state < (RANS_LIMIT) && inPos > 0)
148 state = (state << 8) | in[--inPos];
149
150 return s;
151}

153std::vector<uint8_t> decodeRansStream(const CompressedBrick& brick, const RansModel& model)
154{
155 std::vector<uint8_t> repacked;
156 repacked.reserve((brick.encodedData.size() - 4 + 1) / 2); // rough estimate
157
158 uint32_t state = 0;
159 size_t inPos = brick.encodedData.size();
160
161 assert(inPos >= 4);
162
163 // read little-endian state from the END
164 uint32_t b0 = brick.encodedData[--inPos];
165 uint32_t b1 = brick.encodedData[--inPos];
166 uint32_t b2 = brick.encodedData[--inPos];
167 uint32_t b3 = brick.encodedData[--inPos];
168 state = (b0 << 24) | (b1 << 16) | (b2 << 8) | b3;
169
170 // Decode nibbles until we exhaust encodedData
171 size_t symbolsDecoded = 0;
172 while (symbolsDecoded < brick.nSymbols)
173 {
174 uint8_t hi = ransDecodeSymbol(state, brick.encodedData, inPos, model) & 0x0F;
175 symbolsDecoded++;
176
177 uint8_t lo = 0;
178 if (symbolsDecoded < brick.nSymbols)
179 {
180 lo = ransDecodeSymbol(state, brick.encodedData, inPos, model) & 0x0F;
181 symbolsDecoded++;
182 }
183
184 repacked.push_back((hi << 4) | lo);
185 }
186
187 return repacked;
188}
